reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 11 points better, in a game of about 230 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Kings.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Kings (revenge).
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 76 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 203 and 252 total points.
